geometry_input_policy: PRP geometry ledger remains untouched; no event fields written into geometry rows.
daily_primary_join: interval intersection between PRP episode and historical onset interval; zero halo

coarse_precision_rule.aggregate_statistic: max frozen geometry episode score within interval
coarse_precision_rule.secondary_exposure: number of geometry-episode days in interval

dense_daily.statistic: mean daily event count on PRP episode days minus non-episode days
dense_daily.secondary: rank correlation of daily count with frozen geometry score
dense_daily.null: circular shift complete historical daily series

coarse_native.statistic: native-resolution onset overlap with geometry aggregated to same resolution

missingness_rule: structural missing periods excluded from numerator and denominator
multiple_testing: Holm across all primary source_id × {W_DIR,W_SHELL} tests
event_name_policy: event-name strings masked in first join output; unmask only after statistical output hashed
prohibited: changing PRP ranking from historical information
daily exact-match claims for month/year-only events
